menu.note: Roast the salmon and cook the quinoa Sunday; Tuesday is a reheat.
Also made Sunday. It thickens overnight, so loosen it with water when reheating.
No cooking — assembled from the pantry when the batch food runs out.
Buy the trout Saturday where possible. If it comes with the Sunday shop, freeze it on arrival and thaw it in the refrigerator Friday night.

notes: Sunday is the shop-and-batch-cook day: the salmon bowls and the lentil stew are both made then and cover four days. Thursday through Saturday are cooked fresh. Three fatty-fish meals clear the two-per-week floor, and every meal leans on turmeric, ginger, or garlic in cooking amounts. No tree nuts appear anywhere this week — seeds and sesame paste do that job instead. The one timing catch is Saturday's trout: raw fish cannot wait in the refrigerator from Sunday, so buy it that day or freeze it and thaw it Friday night.
